Below lg the active chip is never scrolled into view in the horizontal chip bar (e.g. landing on #mvp at 375px); use nav.scrollTo, not scrollIntoView

Mount always jumps to #slug; reload after manual scroll snaps back
Empty slugs gives activeSlug undefined typed as AwardSlug (unreachable today)
resize recreates the IntersectionObserver on every event without throttling
